CommunityApplications.Profile: Richardson Resources builds No Fixed Address: self-hosted dynamic DNS for Cloudflare. It's a small container that keeps your DNS records pointed at your server's current public IP address, with no third-party account to renew. This repository holds its source, image builds and Unraid template. For help or to report a problem, open an issue at https://github.com/mdr6273/no-fixed-address/issues.
